title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I am educated unemployed since seven yrs, do not have source of income ,totally dependent on my in-laws. I do not have any bank balance,only owned house . I have declared my wife of complete owner of all ornaments which were given in marraige.i need some money to perform some ruhani ilaj. Can i take & use interest money of in-laws or anybody for this purpose. 2761 views Q. dear sir i am a proffesional Graphic Designer & i am working with advertising co. there for may work to create defrent types of ads.Etc in some of work i am using nude whomens or models photograph or modifyings photos its legal or notislam give permisson to do this work. 3186 views Q. Banking Job 3496 views Q. I am working in a Maharashtra state government office where giving bribes( Rishwat) is not a new thing. But I do not accept it. My question is Can I ask the person giving me bribe to pay my Income Tax as I think income tax taken from us is unislamic. It is taken deliberately from us. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 29572 Country: India Title: Is mobile business halal ? Question: as salaam is mobile business halal ? Answer ID: 29572 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 206/176/L=1432) It is halal. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
